headline: "Culprit of Cheong Wa Dae" "Conspiracy Theory": Dispute Over Leveraged ETFs
summary: At a National Assembly audit of the Financial Services Commission, lawmakers disputed who was responsible for introducing single-stock leveraged products. The opposition alleged Blue House interference, and FSC Chairman Lee Eok-won defended the agency's process.
why: Leveraged ETFs amplify daily returns of underlying stocks, so regulators' decisions on them affect retail trading risk and product approval standards in the Korean market.
